content: Avoidance of overlapping of directly adjacent intervals within CompuMethod s Intervals of a given CompuMethod may be located di- rectly adjacent to each other. This means that the upperLimit of one CompuScale has the same numerical value as the lowerLimit of another CompuScale defined within the context of the CompuMethod . In this case, it is necessary to properly set the attribute CompuScale . lower- Limit . intervalType or CompuScale . upperLimit . intervalType in order to avoid an overlapping. Specifically, one of the interval boundaries shall be set to intervalType . open in order to avoid an overlapping.
